new_candidates.date_enacted: 2026-02-18, Parma Township Board adopted Data Center Moratorium No. 2026-3; notice published 2026-02-27.
new_candidates.duration: One year from adoption, to allow the Township to study and potentially adopt data-center regulations.
new_candidates.legal_basis: Data Center Moratorium No. 2026-3, Parma Township Board
new_candidates.trigger: Township needed time to study and potentially adopt regulations governing data centers.
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-08-19. The Township's adopted one-year moratorium bars permitting, consideration, approval, location, erection, construction, review, and installation of data centers while it studies regulations.
new_candidates.affected_projects: All data centers in Parma Township; no project-specific exception is stated in the published notice.
